statement: Exactly one owner admits membership-changing replica operations on partitions: the ReplicaPlacementOwner on the Raft leader of replica_operations-p1, whose conditional ledger insert is the one canonical owner of target-wide and source-wide occupancy. It recomputes every partition's placement deficit from committed inputs at recorded positions on any committed change to the ledger, the committed node/formation answer, SERVICES or PARTITIONS, and admits in one priority order (ledger, priority control-plane, then after the published formation fact nodes-p1, system, user) through one conditional ledger INSERT evaluated at Raft apply that enforces at most one unresolved operation per entity, at most K_src copy-phase operations per copy-source node, at most K_tgt per target node, and ledger self-move exclusivity, with capacity counted only from committed ledger rows. A refusal leaves the candidate waiting under a typed reason that names its clearing committed event; a terminal commit triggers the next admission in the same step; no timer is a liveness mechanism, and the one resync admits nothing in acceptance. Spread is counted in declared hosts, never node ids. No per-entity rebalancer, planner, follow-up or cleanup path creates a membership-changing operation. The wake/stagger/Phase-B series (f0dfc1a2b, 17194cf83, 4f7fc3691, 4c7b69804, 540418614, de9fe14e8, 380fc5f8b), the 70 s background priority-spread fence and its under-spread exemption, the per-entity placement scheduler, planning gates, wakes, budget gates and ledger interlock are removed from source, tests, contracts, baselines and documentation, not disabled.

constraints.statement: Bounded repair of the defect class D1 (no owner of the placement work queue) and the pre-gate mechanism measured on 219c27bfe (background wave admitted from the seed at Phase B concurrency with no capacity rule; capacity freed only by polling, stagger and safety timers; first unmet predicate c-replica-operations-quiet). Owner decision D1 = (b), 2026-11-17: this Quest's physical receipt (lab-drain-mechanism-and-metrics-product-defaults) is the mechanism and its drain metrics, measured on the lab at product defaults on fresh formations of the registered journey: the journey's first unmet predicate is no longer c-replica-operations-quiet through a placement stall or timer; the drain completes with zero FAILED placement operations; the authoritative ledger time series never shows more than K_src unresolved copy-phase operations per copy source nor K_tgt per target; placementResyncAdmissions is 0; and the times to FORMED and to quiescence are recorded per run. The three-consecutive journey (scenario-green-three-consecutive) is NOT a receipt of this Quest: it stays solely the receipt of the service quest fresh-formation-user-table-routability, gated on the separate founding-membership Quest (one founding voter on the seed, up-replication by ADD, no even voter set). Neither receipt is copied into the other. A remaining cause outside this owner (for example per-copy seed cost) is recorded as the remaining service blocker with its owner, and this Quest's scope is not enlarged except by an explicit recorded widening (R16).

No timeout, bound, retry count, delay or polling interval is added or changed to obtain liveness. The placement owner arms exactly one timer, the resync (PLACEMENT_RESYNC_INTERVAL_MS, declared once), and the reproducer runs with it never firing; every admission in the reproducer is caused by a committed change delivered in the same step. Existing execution-side cadences of the workflow owner (dispatch retry, observed-progress retry, executor-outcome retry, operation read retry) are stepped by name as in the sibling harness and are not placement mechanisms. In acceptance runs the counter placementResyncAdmissions is 0.

The mechanisms of f0dfc1a2b, 17194cf83, 4f7fc3691, 4c7b69804, 540418614, de9fe14e8 and 380fc5f8b that schedule, wake, stagger, exempt or widen placement (continuation-wake-coordinator.js, the slot/continuation/traffic-ready wakes, TRAFFIC_READY_STAGGER_*, SLOT_WAKE_STAGGER_*, MAX_SLOT_RELEASE_HANDOFF_HOPS, the 3x safety cadence, the lastCheckAtMs/lastStateChangeTime resets from outside the owner, isPartitionTrafficReady's absent-state fallback, isPartitionBelowDeclaredDistinctHostSpread and its call sites, Phase B in system-spread-transition-policy.js, the four-source target-slot gate, the below-spread move limit and executor re-sort, VOTER_READY_CHECK_INTERVAL_MS 50 ms restored to its pre-series value pending its own event owner) are deleted together with the 70 s fence and release tracker. A census test pins their absence by closure over identifiers, constants, exports, log message ids and file names. Tests that pin only the mechanism are deleted and listed; tests that pin a surviving property are restated against the owner (list in the design, section 1.4). The impact contracts phase-b-system-spread-policy-admission and readiness-lifecycle-traffic-ready-rebalancer-wake and their coupled pairs are deleted or retargeted. Non-placement hunks of those commits (bootstrap-readiness-lifecycle-source, CDC readiness retryability, harness logTail and spread summary, fix A's split of the visibility predicate) are classified individually and are not removed by this Quest; findings on them are routed to their owners.

One semantic owner decides which membership-changing operation is admitted next, and one repository entry (the conditional insert) persists every new replica operation, used by the placement owner and, for founding creates and runtime services, by their existing owners. No per-entity rebalancer, MovePlanner caller, priority-recovery follow-up, failed-create cleanup, topology drain or ledger-quorum cure calls it. A static check proves the caller set.

No cache read decides admission (the cache is a trigger only); no read merges two sources for one fact; no snake/camel alias reads, ?.() feature probes, defaulted counts or try/catch-return-default in the owner or its admission path; no old placement path behind a flag; no compatibility reader for removed state. Durable rows written by earlier versions are read only through the canonical row decoder; no migration of historical rows.

K_src, K_tgt and the copy-phase step set are declared once (owner constants and replica-operation-step-policy.js). Capacity is evaluated inside the conditional INSERT against all committed replica_operations rows at apply, unscoped by node. No in-memory reservation, creation intent, owner-scoped repository observation (SELECT_INCOMPLETE_OPERATIONS bound to the caller's node id), per-process lane or cache row contributes to a capacity decision. The witness for target occupancy (test/rebalancer/placement-admission-cross-coordinator-target-census.test.js) uses real coordinators with their own caches sharing one durable SQLite-backed operation store with held cache publication, exercises the creation path a placement decider's coordinator uses, and observes refusal and admission at the durable store and the entry's answer, never through a statement shape; it does not use test/rebalancer/test-helpers.js createTestCoordinator (its replica_operations interpreter evaluates OR as AND, lines 1150-1168), and that double is replaced by execution of the canonical SQL in this Quest. Routed system writes pass SQLQueryEngine/SQLParser, which refuses INSERT ... SELECT (sql-parser.js:523-530): the admission statement's shape is WP-E's first falsifier, not a property of the witness.

A move whose operation reached FAILED while the entity's membership is unchanged is admitted again, as a new operation, on the commit of that terminal: no timer, poll or second delivery of the terminal row is needed. The retained FAILED row is never overwritten, reused or shadowed; a deterministic operation identity never collides with a retained terminal row of the same move. Witnessed in the reproducer by a failed create of the ledger's own move, as the pre-gate's ledger REPLACE failed and was created again.
No operation of a lower class is admitted while the ledger partition has an admissible move waiting; this holds after a failed ledger move as before it.

Founding creates of a new user table's partitions (the provisioning owner's genesis ADDs) are not delayed by the background placement drain beyond the shared capacity rule. The formation reproducer cannot host this (its SQL engine is a cache seam with no CREATE TABLE path); the witness runs the real provisioning owner over a world with an in-flight drain and is part of reproducer-and-owned-roots-green.

The remove-safety floor as amended by fix A (f50344e98: one fail-closed voter floor, voter-ready rows on READY-lease nodes >= minReplicaCount for every removal) and its committed-node authority are not changed. The owner consumes projectQuorumAfterRemoval only to avoid planning a certainly-parked REMOVE. The independent verifier attempts the counterexample of removing a seed replica while the only other voters are SYNCING.

The sealed constraints of formation-ready-lease-independent-of-spread hold unchanged: ready-means-node-can-serve, no-pre-ready-placement (a target needs a valid READY lease in the committed node answer, re-checked at dispatch), one-formation-fact-consumed-where-it-protects (the owner consumes the published priority-partition summary through the committed publication read and admits non-priority classes only when FORMED; UNSTATED and PENDING are not FORMED), dead-ready-node-witnessed and join-core-coupling (its DT witnesses stay green).

Spread is counted in declared hosts (NODES.host_id from explicit node configuration), never inferred from node id, provider id or missing topology. Every report and receipt states its unit. A synthetic 5-node/4-host topology witnesses host-distinct placement; physical host spread is proven on the lab.

Before any source change, R09 supersession records are appended for each sealed claim this Quest contradicts, quoting the sealed sentence; the census of sealed quests whose statements bind a removed mechanism (at least blocked-spread-evaluation-event-wake, effective-placement-serial-priority-planner (priority-only scope), hold-engagement-single-owner-table, operation-ledger-self-move-hold-engagement, operation-ledger-self-move-hold-fairness, operation-ledger-self-move-waiter-fairness v1-v3, operation-ledger-self-move-holder-release-on-engagement v1-v2, priority-recovery-add-dispatch-cadence, movielens-create-budget-intent-serialization, ledger-quorum-spread-hold-cure-drain-admission v1-v2, operation-ledger-quorum-authoritative-release, formation-ledger-quorum-spread-first, formation-control-plane-move-interlock, spread-fence-proven-local-leadership-read) is recorded with a superseded or retained verdict each; and the contract-first transition record (design section 2.12) is written to evidence/transition.md.

No ratchet baseline is raised; baselines and the fallback census change only by removed occurrences; nothing moves into a file near the size limit; every checker the Solver and the pre-commit hook run is clean on the change set.

Suites and live runs execute on the lab through scripts/lab.js under the machine lock with thermal headroom. Physical runs use product default timeouts (owner decision 2026-11-17): no joining HTTP, leadership-wait, transport or readiness-attempt override in the lab configuration or the deployer. Full node logs and the harness report are retained per run, with the ledger time series of unresolved operations per copy source.

Any source change is verified on the exact candidate by a fresh independent verifier before audit and landing (note --verification ... --verifier subagent:<id> --verdict approve), against the templates listed below.
